'''Skoo Weebe''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] active during the then-ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He had multiple military [[Officer/Legends|officers]] on his payroll and,<ref name="SLI" /> by [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Secrets for Sale" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> was selling military secrets on the open market.<ref name="SLI" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual associated with one of the two sides in the Republic&ndash;Empire struggle sent a companion to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] into Weebe's [[Computer/Legends|computers]] to discover his sources. The companion found a list of the military officers on Weebe's payroll as well as information on the movement of [[Troop/Legends|troops]] of the faction opposing that of their associate's.<ref name="SLI" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Skoo Weebe was mentioned in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the Crew Skill mission "Secrets for Sale," though the information about the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="SLI" />
